data.summary: git commit concluding a merge is refused by the stale-rules check when the base moved after MERGE_HEAD was taken: _concludes_merge_of requires MERGE_HEAD to contain the CURRENT base tip, so a staged merge cannot be committed while main advances (had to build the merge commit with commit-tree). Repro: git merge main (conflict), main gains a rules-file commit, git commit -> 'main changed the project's rules'

data.body:
Fixes bug Bff82f56207: git commit concluding a merge is refused by the stale-rules check when the base moved after MERGE_HEAD was taken: _concludes_merge_of requires MERGE_HEAD to contain the CURRENT base tip, so a staged merge cannot be committed while main advances (had to build the merge commit with commit-tree). Repro: git merge main (conflict), main gains a rules-file commit, git commit -> 'main changed the project's rules' Found on DX-health-watch.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bff82f56207 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bff82f56207 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Bff82f56207: git commit concluding a merge is refused by the stale-rules check when the base moved after MERG...
